shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- git ---\\n' && git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"createMessageHandler|list_sessions|SessionStore|sessionStore|IncomingMessage|OutgoingMessage\" src test specs . --glob '"'!node_modules'"' --glob '"'!*acceptance*'"' | head -240
rg --files | rg 'messageHandler|validation|sender|messages.*test|ws.*test|spec-links'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/types/messages.ts
sed -n '90,145p' src/index.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '1,130p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,110p' src/types/sessionStore.ts
rg -n \"specs/.*#|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -100
rg --files src | rg 'messages.*test|signature.*test|index.*test'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/infrastructure/stores/sessionStoreListSignature.test.ts
sed -n '1,170p' src/index.test.ts
sed -n '1,140p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs
sed -n '1,100p' package.json
rg -n \"validated by:\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|@spec|spec:\" scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -160
sed -n '110,155p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
nl -ba src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
rg -n \"#\\d+|spec.*anchor|spec:\" .lore scripts src --glob '*.mjs' --glob '*.ts' | head -160
rg --files specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo \""'$0"'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts && git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts && git commit -m "Add conversation list frame types" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
